scheme_name: Additional Pension to 100% Disabled Ex-Serviceman having Children
other_conditions: Applicant must be an ex‑serviceman released from the Armed Forces due to 100% disability or permanent incapacity attributable to service
Benefit is limited to a maximum of three children per eligible person
The additional pension terminates for a child when the child dies, reaches 20 years of age, gets married, or becomes employed, whichever occurs first
The eligible person must submit a half‑yearly certificate of eligibility in Form III to the Secretary of the District Sainik Board during June or December
The eligible person/guardian must inform the Secretary of any change in the status of the children (death, age, marriage, or employment)
benefits_summary: Provides an additional monthly pension of ₹100‑₹200 per child (up to three children) to eligible 100% disabled ex‑servicemen.
